name: Shelf Picked

angles.text: Courier errands between Stormwind's libraries and local gathering places are part of everyday life in the capital, even amid wider tensions in the kingdom.

faq.answer: A librarian overseeing the Stormwind library gives you the errand after receiving Roy Lewells's note. The librarian confirms the requested books are in stock and asks you to pull them from the shelves.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Shelf Picked?

faq.answer: Roy Lewells organizes a local reading group based in Stormwind's Park. He sends couriers to collect books from the library for the group's after-hours discussions in a cellar.
The books are collected at a Stormwind library. The librarian keeps the inventory records while you search the shelves for Roy Lewells's requested titles.
faq.q: Where does the book collection take place?

faq.answer: Roy Lewells needs the books for an informal book club whose members gather for lively discussions after hours in a cellar.
faq.q: Why does Roy Lewells need these books?

aliases: am i responsible for returning books
faq.answer: No. With Roy Lewells's note, you act as an official courier. His establishment is responsible for returning the borrowed books.
faq.q: Are you responsible for returning the borrowed books?

aliases: where do you turn in shelf picked
faq.answer: You bring the collected books to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
faq.q: Where do you bring the books once retrieved?

sections.body: Roy Lewells has sent a note asking for several books from the Stormwind library. The librarian checks the list and confirms every title is in stock. The books are there for you to find and pull from the shelves. The librarian stays at the desk to keep the inventory records.
sections.title: An Errand for the Stacks

sections.body: Roy Lewells's note makes you an official courier, so you are not responsible for returning the borrowed books. That duty belongs to Lewells's establishment. Once you bring the volumes to the Park, Roy prepares them for lively after-hours discussions in a cellar. The books have an exotic smell.
sections.title: The Cellar Reading Club

summary: In Stormwind, Roy Lewells sends a runner to gather books for a reading group in the Park.
